verdict.rationale: Gumloop's evidence shows only a self-contained Python/JS SDK installer for calling its cloud API, plus cloud-hosted agent/workflow execution, triggers, and MCP connectors — there is no mention of a local execution engine, offline/dev-instance mode, or CI testing workflow. The SDK still targets Gumloop's hosted service rather than enabling local runs. Missing for 10: any documentation of local workflow execution, a dev/staging instance, or CI integration guidance.
